text: The meeting this program built toward: the CDO, Compliance, and all three domain owners, seeing the finished program -- and an honest account of a real gap.
Oracle's 438,000 and Salesforce's 561,000 both stay exactly as they were -- now two separately governed terms, Active Customer and Engaged Account. The warehouse's blended 497,000 is retired.
The Oracle gap has a paper trail. Our own scan flagged it provisional. The reporting view was genuinely clean. The base table behind it never got registered, until an audit found it.
That's not governance failing -- a program with no audit never finds a gap like this. CUSTOMERS_RAW is fixed, and a monthly check now runs across every source.
Leadership has the full picture, win and gap together. Next: writing the documents that let this program run without you in the room.
